description: NAPA is one of the four National Performing Arts spaces in Trinidad and Tobago. It officially opened on November 9, 2009. The Public Auditorium at NAPA was developed to play a pivotal role in the national plan for development of the arts and culture in Trinidad and Tobago. Listed opening hours: 8:00AM - 4:00PM. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
